phrases.arabic: إلهِي أَحْمَـدُكَ ـ وَأَنْتَ لِلْحَمْدِ أَهْلٌ ـ
phrases.english: 1.My God, I praise You, - and You art worthy of praise -

phrases.arabic: عَلَى حُسْنِ صَنِيعِكَ إلَيَّ، وَسُبُـوغِ نَعْمَآئِكَ عَلَيَّ،
phrases.english: 2.for Your benefaction toward me, the lavishness of Your favours toward me,
3.and Your plentiful bestowal upon me,
4.and for showing bounty toward me through Your mercy
5.and lavishing Your favour upon me.

phrases.arabic: فَقَدِ اصْطَنَعْتَ عِنْدِي ما يَعْجِزُ عَنُهُ شُكْرِي، وَلَوْلاَ إحْسَانُكَ، إلَيَّ
phrases.english: 6.You hast done well toward me and I am incapable of thanking You. Were it not for Your beneficence toward me
7.and the lavishness of Your favours upon me,

phrases.arabic: مَا  بَلَغْتُ إحْرازَ حَظِّي، وَلاَ إصْلاَحَ نَفْسِي،
phrases.english: 8.I would not have reached the taking of my share nor would my soul have been set right,
9.but You began with beneficence toward me,
10.provided me sufficiency in all my affairs,
11.turned away from me the toil of affliction,
12.and held back from me the feared decree.

phrases.arabic: إلهِي فَكَمْ مِنْ بَلاء جَاهِد قَدْ صَرَفْتَ عَنِّي،
phrases.english: 13.My God, how many a toilsome affliction which You hast turned away from me!

phrases.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ نِعْمَة سَابِغَة أَقْرَرْتَ بِهَا عَيْنِي،
phrases.english: 14.How many a lavish favour with which You hast gladdened my eye!

phrases.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ صَنِيعَة كَرِيمَة  لَكَ عِنْدِي.
phrases.english: 15.How many a generous benefaction of Thine which is present with me!

phrases.arabic: أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَجَبْتَ عِنْدَ الاضْطِرَارِ دَعْوَتِي،
phrases.english: 16.It is You who responded to my supplication at the time of distress,
17.released me from my slip in stumbling,
18.and took my enemies to task for doing wrong to me.

phrases.arabic: إلهِي مَا وَجَدْتُكَ بَخِيلاً حِينَ سَأَلْتُكَ،
phrases.english: 19.My God, I did not find You a miser when I asked of You
20.nor a withholder when I desired from You.

phrases.arabic: بل وَجَدْتُكَ لِدُعَآئِي سَامِعاً، وَلِمَطَالِبِي مُعْطِياً،
phrases.english: 21.No, 1 found You a hearer of my supplication and a bestower of my requests;
22.I found Your favours toward me

phrases.arabic: فِي كُلِّ شَأْن مِنْ شَأْنِي، وَكُلِّ زَمَان مِنْ زَمَانِي،
phrases.english: 23.lavish in my every situation and in my every time.

phrases.arabic: فَأَنْتَ عِنْدِي مَحْمُودٌ، وَصَنِيعُكَ لَدَيَّ مَبْرُورٌ،
phrases.english: 24.So You art praised by me and Your benefaction honoured.

phrases.arabic: تَحْمَدُكَ نَفْسِي وَلِسَانِيْ وَعَقْلِي حَمْداً يَبْلُغُ الوَفَآءَ وَحَقِيقَةَ الشُّكْرِ،
phrases.english: 25.My soul, my tongue, and my intelligence praise You, a praise that reaches fulfilment and the reality of thanksgiving,
26.a praise that attains to Your good pleasure with me -

phrases.arabic: فَنَجِّنِي مِنْ سَخَطِكَ يَا كَهْفِي حِينَ تُعْيينِي الْمَذَاهِبُ،
phrases.english: 27.so deliver me from Your displeasure! O my cave when the ways thwart me!
28.O He who releases me from my stumble!

phrases.arabic: فَلَوْلاَ سَتْرُكَ عَوْرَتِي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَفْضُوحِينَ،
phrases.english: 29.Were it not for Your covering my shameful defects, I would be one of the disgraced.
30.O my confirmer through help!

phrases.arabic: فَلَوْلاَ نَصْرُكَ إيَّايَ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَغْلُوبِينَ،
phrases.english: 31.Were it not for Your helping me, I would be one of the overcome!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ وَضَعَتْ لَهُ الْمُلُوكُ نِيرَ الْمَذَلَّةِ عَلى أَعْنَاقِهَا،
phrases.english: 32.O He before whom kings place the yoke of lowliness around their necks,

phrases.arabic: فَهُمْ مِنْ سَطَواتِهِ خَائِفُونَ، وَيَا أَهْلَ التَّقْوَى،
phrases.english: 33.fearing His penalties! O worthy of reverent fear!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لَهُ الأَسْمَآءُ الْحُسْنى أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَعْفُوَ عَنِّي،
phrases.english: 34.O He to whom belong the names most beautiful! I ask You to pardon me
35.and to forgive me, for I am not innocent that I should offer excuses,
36.nor a possessor of strength that I should gain victory,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ مَفَرَّ لِي فَأَفِرَّ. وَأَسْتَقِيْلُكَ عَثَراتِي،
phrases.english: 37.nor have I any place of flight that I should flee! I ask You to release me from my stumbles,

phrases.arabic: وَأَتَنَصَّلُ إلَيْكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي الَّتِي قَدْ أَوْبَقَتْنِي،
phrases.english: 38.and before You I disavow my sins, which have laid me waste,
39.encompassed me, and destroyed me!
40.I flee from them to You, my Lord, turning repentantly,
41.so turn toward me, seeking refuge, so grant me refuge, asking sanctuary,

phrases.arabic: فَلاَ تَخْذُلْنِي سَآئِلاً، فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي مُعْتَصِماً،
phrases.english: 42.so abandon me not, requesting, so deprive me not, holding fast,

phrases.arabic: فَلاَ تُسْلِمْنِي دَاعِياً، فَلاَ تَرُدَّنِي خَائِباً،
phrases.english: 43.so leave me not, supplicating, so send me not back disappointed!
44.I have supplicated You, my Lord, as one miserable, abased,

phrases.arabic: مُشْفِقاً، خَائِفاً، وَجِلاً، فَقِيراً، مُضْطَرّاً، إلَيْكَ
phrases.english: 45.apprehensive, fearful, quaking, poor, driven to have recourse to You!

phrases.arabic: أَشْكُو إلَيْكَ يَا إلهِي ضَعْفَ نَفْسِي
phrases.english: 46.I complain to You, my God, of my soul - which is too weak
47.to hurry to that which You hast promised Your friends
48.or to avoid that against which You hast cautioned Your enemies -
49.and of the multitude of my concerns, and of my soul's confusing thoughts.
50.My God, You hast not disgraced me through my secret thoughts
51.or destroyed me because of my misdeeds! I call upon You, and You respondest,
52.even if I am slow when You callest upon me.
53.I ask You everything I want of my needs,

phrases.arabic: وَحَيْثُ  مَا كُنْتُ وَضَعْتُ عِنْدَكَ سِرِّي،
phrases.english: 54.and I deposit with You my secret wherever I may be.

phrases.arabic: فَلاَ أَدْعُو سِوَاكَ، وَلاَ أَرْجُو غَيْرَكَ،
phrases.english: 55.I supplicate no one besides You, and I hope for no one other than You.

phrases.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ، تَسْمَعُ مَنْ شَكَا إلَيْكَ،
phrases.english: 56.At Your service! At Your service! You hearest him who complains to You!
57.You receivest him who has confidence in You!
58.You savest him who holds fast to You!
59.You givest relief to him who seeks shelter in You!

phrases.arabic: إلهِي  فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي خَيْرَ الآخِرَةِ وَالأُولى لِقِلَّةِ شُكْرِي،
phrases.english: 60.My God, so deprive me not of the good of the last world and the first because of the paucity of my thanksgiving

phrases.arabic: وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا تَعْلَمُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي،
phrases.english: 61.and forgive me the sins of mine which You knowest!
62.If You chastisest, I am the wrongdoer, the neglecter,
63.the negligent, the sinner, the derelict, the sluggard,
64.the heedless of the share of my soul!
65.And if You forgivest - You art the Most Merciful of the merciful!
